function tag(): string { return "x"; }
console.log(tag`a`);
console.log(tag`a${1}b`);
function two(s: TemplateStringsArray, n: number) { return s[0] + n; }
console.log(two`a${1}`);
console.log(two`a`);
function any(...a: unknown[]) { return a.length; }
console.log(any`x${1}`);
function many(s: TemplateStringsArray, a: number, b?: number) { return a; }
console.log(many`a${1}${2}${3}`);
function over(s: TemplateStringsArray): string;
function over(s: TemplateStringsArray, a: number, b: number): string;
function over(...a: unknown[]) { return ''; }
console.log(over`a${1}`);
